charts.name: Measurement contract
charts.text: Primary KPI: task queued_at to first server-received non-empty model delta or tool call. Server logs are authoritative; select the minimum queuedToUsefulMs per task. Never combine KVM and TCG benchmark cohorts.

query.apl:
['moltnet-logs']
| where body == "task.readiness.useful_event_received"
| extend taskId = tostring(['attributes.taskId']), latency = todouble(['attributes.queuedToUsefulMs'])
| summarize latency = min(latency) by taskId
| summarize p50 = percentile(latency, 50), p95 = percentile(latency, 95), p99 = percentile(latency, 99), tasks = count()

charts.name: First useful event latency over time

query.apl:
['moltnet-logs']
| where body == "task.readiness.useful_event_received"
| extend taskId = tostring(['attributes.taskId']), latency = todouble(['attributes.queuedToUsefulMs'])
| summarize latency = min(latency) by taskId, bin_auto(_time)
| summarize p50 = percentile(latency, 50), p95 = percentile(latency, 95), p99 = percentile(latency, 99) by bin_auto(_time)

['moltnet-logs']
| where body == "task.readiness.useful_event_received"
| extend kind = tostring(['attributes.usefulEventKind'])
| summarize events = count() by kind

['moltnet-traces']
| extend operation = tostring(name)
| where operation startswith "moltnet."
| summarize p50 = percentile(todouble(['duration']), 50), p95 = percentile(todouble(['duration']), 95), p99 = percentile(todouble(['duration']), 99), count = count() by operation
| order by p95 desc

['moltnet-logs']
| where body == "task.readiness.useful_event_received"
| project _time, ['attributes.taskId'], ['attributes.attemptN'], ['attributes.usefulEventKind'], ['attributes.queuedToUsefulMs']
| order by _time desc
| take 100

description: Task queue-to-first-useful-action latency and daemon/runtime phase drilldown.
name: MoltNet Task Readiness
